package.name: Docker Engine (Ubuntu)
package.summary: Ubuntu-packaged container engine; separate from Docker Desktop and Docker upstream repositories.
package.vendor: Docker and Moby contributors; Ubuntu packaging

notes: Ubuntu docker.io distribution package; this is not Docker Desktop or docker-ce from the Docker upstream repository.
Native packages may install and start a system daemon. Review service configuration, networking, disk use and privileges before approving.
Docker-group membership can grant root-equivalent access; group changes require separate explicit consent.

environment_guidance: CLI presence alone does not distinguish Desktop from Engine or prove daemon health; native inventory and source-specific verification are required.
